bit: It's Tuesday and the folder is still the same week. Twenty-five packs. The Monday autopsy is still warm. I brought a new toilet joke to a locked door.
target: Jesse, the comic who thinks a new day is a new week
setup: He showed up on Tuesday with a fresh bit and the same weekly key.
surprise: The door did not reset because the calendar square did.
punch: Tuesday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
tags: New day, same week, same toilets.
The open mic is tonight. The autopsy is not.
button: Sacramento has a Tuesday. The mic doesn't double the autopsy.
verdict: Died as a calendar. Make Tuesday the comic who counted the day and ignored the lock.
